derivation: from the alternate of G2203 (Ζεύς) and G5142 (τρέφω);
def: Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an opponent of Christianity

occurrences.text: I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loveth to have the preeminence among them, receiveth us not.
